question: 查询所有产品类别的名称
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM productcategory

question: 统计销售订单总数
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM salesorderheader

question: 列出所有供应商的名称和信用评级
gold_sql: SELECT Name, CreditRating FROM vendor

question: 查询所有部门名称
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM department

question: 统计产品总数
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM product

question: 查询所有计量单位
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM unitmeasure

question: 查询所有联系人类型
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM contacttype

question: 统计员工总数
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employee

question: 查询所有发货方式
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM shipmethod

question: 查询产品子类别名称
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM productsubcategory

question: 查询所有在美国(US)的销售区域及其订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name, COUNT(o.SalesOrderID) AS OrderCount FROM salesterritory t LEFT JOIN salesorderheader o ON t.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID WHERE t.CountryRegionCode = 'US' GROUP BY t.TerritoryID, t.Name

question: 查询零售价大于1000的产品及其类别
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, pc.Name AS CategoryName, p.ListPrice FROM product p JOIN productsubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID WHERE p.ListPrice > 1000

question: 查询产品颜色为红色(Red)的产品数量和平均价格
gold_sql: SELECT Color, COUNT(*) AS ProductCount, AVG(ListPrice) AS AvgPrice FROM product WHERE Color = 'Red' GROUP BY Color

question: 查询安全库存大于500的产品及其库存位置
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, p.SafetyStockLevel, l.Name AS LocationName FROM product p JOIN productinventory pi ON p.ProductID = pi.ProductID JOIN location l ON pi.LocationID = l.LocationID WHERE p.SafetyStockLevel > 500

question: 查询所有销售区域的名称、分组及订单总额
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name, t.`Group`, SUM(o.TotalDue) AS TotalSales FROM salesterritory t JOIN salesorderheader o ON t.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.TerritoryID, t.Name, t.`Group`

question: 查询每个产品类别下有多少个产品
gold_sql: SELECT pc.Name AS CategoryName, COUNT(p.ProductID) AS ProductCount FROM productcategory pc JOIN productsubcategory ps ON pc.ProductCategoryID = ps.ProductCategoryID JOIN product p ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryID, pc.Name

question: 查询每个销售区域的订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name AS Territory, COUNT(o.SalesOrderID) AS OrderCount FROM salesterritory t JOIN salesorderheader o ON t.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.TerritoryID, t.Name ORDER BY OrderCount DESC

question: 查询销售额最高的10个产品
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, SUM(od.LineTotal) AS TotalSales FROM product p JOIN salesorderdetail od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Name ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 10

question: 查询有采购订单的供应商及其订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT v.Name AS VendorName, COUNT(po.PurchaseOrderID) AS OrderCount FROM vendor v JOIN purchaseorderheader po ON v.VendorID = po.VendorID GROUP BY v.VendorID, v.Name ORDER BY OrderCount DESC

question: 查询每个部门的员工数量
gold_sql: SELECT d.Name AS DepartmentName, COUNT(edh.EmployeeID) AS EmployeeCount FROM department d JOIN employeedepartmenthistory edh ON d.DepartmentID = edh.DepartmentID WHERE edh.EndDate IS NULL GROUP BY d.DepartmentID, d.Name ORDER BY EmployeeCount DESC

question: 查询产品及其所属类别名称
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, pc.Name AS CategoryName FROM product p JOIN productsubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID

question: 查询每个客户的订单总金额(前10名)
gold_sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(o.TotalDue) AS TotalAmount FROM customer c JOIN salesorderheader o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC LIMIT 10

question: 查询库存数量低于再订购点的产品
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, pi.Quantity AS CurrentStock, p.ReorderPoint FROM product p JOIN productinventory pi ON p.ProductID = pi.ProductID WHERE pi.Quantity < p.ReorderPoint

question: 查询每种颜色的产品数量，并找出产品数量最多的颜色
gold_sql: SELECT Color, COUNT(*) AS ProductCount FROM product WHERE Color IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Color HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM product WHERE Color IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Color) AS t)

question: 查询有产品的子类别及其平均零售价
gold_sql: SELECT ps.Name AS SubCategory, AVG(p.ListPrice) AS AvgPrice FROM productsubcategory ps JOIN product p ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID GROUP BY ps.ProductSubcategoryID, ps.Name ORDER BY AvgPrice DESC

question: 查询2013年的销售订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM salesorderheader WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2013

question: 查询每个发货方式的使用次数
gold_sql: SELECT sm.Name AS ShipMethod, COUNT(po.PurchaseOrderID) AS UsageCount FROM shipmethod sm JOIN purchaseorderheader po ON sm.ShipMethodID = po.ShipMethodID GROUP BY sm.ShipMethodID, sm.Name

question: 查询利润率高于平均利润率的产品
gold_sql: SELECT Name, StandardCost, ListPrice, (ListPrice - StandardCost) / ListPrice * 100 AS ProfitMarginPct FROM product WHERE ListPrice > 0 AND (ListPrice - StandardCost) / ListPrice > (SELECT AVG((ListPrice - StandardCost) / ListPrice) FROM product WHERE ListPrice > 0) ORDER BY ProfitMarginPct DESC LIMIT 20

question: 查询每年在线订单和非在线订单的数量和金额对比(返回年份、订单类型、数量、金额)
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS Year, OnlineOrderFlag, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount, SUM(TotalDue) AS TotalAmount FROM salesorderheader GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), OnlineOrderFlag ORDER BY Year, OnlineOrderFlag

question: 查询每个国家的客户订单总额(返回国家代码如US/CA/AU)
gold_sql: SELECT t.CountryRegionCode, SUM(o.TotalDue) AS TotalAmount FROM salesterritory t JOIN salesorderheader o ON t.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.CountryRegionCode ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC

question: 查询有产品的型号及其产品数量
gold_sql: SELECT pm.Name AS ModelName, COUNT(p.ProductID) AS ProductCount FROM productmodel pm JOIN product p ON pm.ProductModelID = p.ProductModelID GROUP BY pm.ProductModelID, pm.Name ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

question: 查询有产品评论的产品名称和评分
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, pr.Rating FROM product p JOIN productreview pr ON p.ProductID = pr.ProductID

question: 查询采购金额最高的5个供应商
gold_sql: SELECT v.Name AS VendorName, SUM(po.TotalDue) AS TotalAmount FROM vendor v JOIN purchaseorderheader po ON v.VendorID = po.VendorID GROUP BY v.VendorID, v.Name ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 查询产品的平均库存数量按库位分组
gold_sql: SELECT l.Name AS LocationName, AVG(pi.Quantity) AS AvgStock FROM location l JOIN productinventory pi ON l.LocationID = pi.LocationID GROUP BY l.LocationID, l.Name

question: 查询每个班次的员工数量
gold_sql: SELECT s.Name AS ShiftName, COUNT(DISTINCT edh.EmployeeID) AS EmployeeCount FROM shift s JOIN employeedepartmenthistory edh ON s.ShiftID = edh.ShiftID WHERE edh.EndDate IS NULL GROUP BY s.ShiftID, s.Name

question: 查询每个销售人员的销售总额和订单数量
gold_sql: SELECT sp.SalesPersonID, COUNT(o.SalesOrderID) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.TotalDue) AS TotalSales FROM salesperson sp JOIN salesorderheader o ON sp.SalesPersonID = o.SalesPersonID GROUP BY sp.SalesPersonID ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

question: 查询购买过自行车(Bikes)类产品的客户数量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM salesorderheader o JOIN salesorderdetail od ON o.SalesOrderID = od.SalesOrderID JOIN product p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN productsubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID WHERE pc.Name = 'Bikes'

question: 查询没有销售记录的产品
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name FROM product p LEFT JOIN salesorderdetail od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID WHERE od.ProductID IS NULL

question: 查询供应超过5种产品的供应商
gold_sql: SELECT v.Name AS VendorName, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.ProductID) AS ProductCount FROM vendor v JOIN productvendor pv ON v.VendorID = pv.VendorID GROUP BY v.VendorID, v.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pv.ProductID) > 5 ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

question: 查询每月的销售趋势
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS Year, MONTH(OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(TotalDue) AS MonthlySales, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM salesorderheader GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), MONTH(OrderDate) ORDER BY Year, Month

question: 查询订单金额高于平均值的订单
gold_sql: SELECT SalesOrderID, TotalDue FROM salesorderheader WHERE TotalDue > (SELECT AVG(TotalDue) FROM salesorderheader) ORDER BY TotalDue DESC

question: 查询产品利润率最高的类别
gold_sql: SELECT pc.Name AS Category, AVG((p.ListPrice - p.StandardCost) / p.ListPrice * 100) AS AvgProfitMargin FROM productcategory pc JOIN productsubcategory ps ON pc.ProductCategoryID = ps.ProductCategoryID JOIN product p ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID WHERE p.ListPrice > 0 GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryID, pc.Name ORDER BY AvgProfitMargin DESC

question: 查询每个区域的年度销售额
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name AS Territory, YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS Year, SUM(o.TotalDue) AS YearlySales FROM salesterritory t JOIN salesorderheader o ON t.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.TerritoryID, t.Name, YEAR(o.OrderDate) ORDER BY t.Name, Year

question: 查询每年生产工单的完成情况统计(按年分组，返回总订单数和完成订单数)
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(StartDate) AS Year, COUNT(*) AS TotalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN StockedQty >= OrderQty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CompletedOrders FROM workorder GROUP BY YEAR(StartDate) ORDER BY Year

question: 查询订单最多的前10个州/省
gold_sql: SELECT sp.Name AS StateProvince, COUNT(o.SalesOrderID) AS OrderCount FROM stateprovince sp JOIN address a ON sp.StateProvinceID = a.StateProvinceID JOIN salesorderheader o ON a.AddressID = o.ShipToAddressID GROUP BY sp.StateProvinceID, sp.Name ORDER BY OrderCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: 计算每个产品类别的销售总额和占比(占比保留6位小数，不使用ROUND)
gold_sql: SELECT pc.Name AS Category, SUM(od.LineTotal) AS Sales, SUM(od.LineTotal) / (SELECT SUM(LineTotal) FROM salesorderdetail) * 100 AS Percentage FROM productcategory pc JOIN productsubcategory ps ON pc.ProductCategoryID = ps.ProductCategoryID JOIN product p ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN salesorderdetail od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryID, pc.Name ORDER BY Percentage DESC

question: 查询各产品类别下每个产品的销售额排名列表(返回类别名、产品名、销售额)
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT pc.Name AS Category, p.Name AS Product, SUM(od.LineTotal) AS Sales FROM productcategory pc JOIN productsubcategory ps ON pc.ProductCategoryID = ps.ProductCategoryID JOIN product p ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN salesorderdetail od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryID, pc.Name, p.ProductID, p.Name ORDER BY pc.Name, Sales DESC) AS ranked
description: Extra-Hard - 分类产品销售排名

question: 计算订单数>=5的客户的订单数和总消费金额(按总消费降序取前20名)
gold_sql: SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(SalesOrderID) AS OrderCount, SUM(TotalDue) AS TotalSpent, AVG(TotalDue) AS AvgOrderValue FROM salesorderheader GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(SalesOrderID) >= 5 ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 20

question: 查询各月各销售区域的销售额(年和月分开为两列，按年月销售额降序)
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS Year, MONTH(o.OrderDate) AS Month, t.Name AS Territory, SUM(o.TotalDue) AS MonthlySales FROM salesorderheader o JOIN salesterritory t ON o.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate), MONTH(o.OrderDate), t.TerritoryID, t.Name ORDER BY Year, Month, MonthlySales DESC
description: Extra-Hard - 月度区域销售排名

question: 查询每个类别中价格最高的产品(如有并列价格的产品全部返回)
gold_sql: SELECT pc.Name AS Category, p.Name AS Product, p.ListPrice FROM productcategory pc JOIN productsubcategory ps ON pc.ProductCategoryID = ps.ProductCategoryID JOIN product p ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID WHERE p.ListPrice = (SELECT MAX(p2.ListPrice) FROM product p2 JOIN productsubcategory ps2 ON p2.ProductSubcategoryID = ps2.ProductSubcategoryID WHERE ps2.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID) ORDER BY pc.Name
description: Extra-Hard - 类别最高价产品(简化版)
